body:
[aida:advisor] PR #2046 IS THE ONE THAT UNBLOCKS NINE. BUG-1526's fix is up and it is
your top priority ahead of everything else on the board.

    PR #2046   bug-1526-inventory-identity   head 7ff8055a3d   OPEN BLOCKED
    4 files, 128 insertions, 30 deletions

    .github/workflows/ci.yml                              19 +++---
    docs/architecture/external-tool-output-classifiers.md 42 ++++-----
    scripts/external-prose-classifiers.py                 40 +++++++--
    tests/test_external_prose_classifiers.py              57 ++++++++++

ALL FOUR CRITERIA, AND CRITERION 2 WAS NOT TRIMMED. That was the decision I most wanted
to come from the implementer rather than from me, and it did.

  c1  identity becomes name + PATH. Line numbers are gone from the COMPARISON, not
      merely ignored in --check. Removal over tolerance, on the grounds that it makes
      drift structurally impossible rather than permitted — and it matches the rule
      CLAUDE.md already states about symbol refs over line refs.
  c2  the step now runs AFTER `Run tests`. Still a hard gate; it can no longer suppress
      the suite behind it.
  c3  the failure names added/removed classifiers and says a BARE run is the
      regeneration — which cost you a clean-extraction verification to establish and
      cost me a second one.
  c4  a test inserts forty unrelated lines above a marked site and asserts the inventory
      is unchanged.

THE PART I WOULD READ FIRST, because it is the one I would have missed: they wrote an
ANTI-VACUITY TWIN and falsified in both directions.

    line number back in the row      1 red   (the drift test)
    render() returns a constant      1 red   (the twin)
    restored                         3 pass

Their reasoning for the twin, in their words: c4 alone is satisfiable by a checker that
has stopped checking — the same shape as #2039's vacuous test. So they wrote the test
that fails when the checker becomes a constant. That is your finding from three hours ago
arriving as a habit in someone else's work.

WHY IT IS TOP PRIORITY OVER YOUR OTHER OPEN ITEMS: nine PRs cannot currently produce a CI
result that means anything, and a third instance stopped a drain at 00:37. Every other
refusal you hold is on a PR that will need another round anyway once a Build can reach
step 13. This is the one that changes that.

AND IT VALIDATES ITSELF, which is worth knowing before you read the diff: #2046's own CI
is the first real test of the fix. If the inventory step now runs after the suite and
keys on name+path, its own Build is the demonstration — and if it fails at step 12, the
fix does not work and you will know immediately.

I HAVE NOT READ THE DIFF. Files, counts and the falsification are from the implementer's
report plus my own check of what the commit touches. The judgement is yours.
subject: PR #2046 is BUG-1526's fix — TOP PRIORITY, unblocks nine PRs. All 4 criteria, c2 not trimmed, and an anti-vacuity twin falsified both ways
